description: Construction of an Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the District General Hospital, Trincomalee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although the contract for the construction of an Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the District General Hospital, Trincomalee had been awarded in the year 2017, the said contract has been canceled in the year 2019 owing to the poor performance of the contractor. Since the construction work of the building had been completed up to the roof at the time the contract was cancelled, it has been identified that it would be more appropriate to complete the remaining construction work as soon as possible. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement a new procurement process to select a suitable contractor to complete the said construction work of the Accident and Emergency treatment Unit at the premises of the District General Hospital, Trincomalee, was approved by the Cabinet.
